_metadata.expectation_basis: Each expectation names the label ingredient that should drive the outcome under the repo's verified safety policy (banned_recalled_ingredients.json and the Phase-3 clinical policy), checked on the raw label before the pipeline ran. Controls are look-alikes that must not be blocked.
_metadata.driver: Blocked: safety_decision.winning_rule equals driver. Caution/no concern: safety_signal_reason starts with driver (dose reasons are matched by the DOSE_OVER_UL prefix because the severity band is a separate display decision); null driver means no stated reason.
